I set up the weekday 17:30 "Pod end of day" job for #strategic-pod, but it is not active yet, and it is not set to Chicago time.

- **Not running:** the Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire until it is started.
- **Wrong time zone:** the scheduler stored the next run as 17:30 UTC. Chicago 17:30 is 22:30 UTC during daylight time, but a fixed UTC schedule will drift an hour when clocks change in November. The scheduler's time zone setting needs checking before this goes live.

I posted two messages in #strategic-pod explaining this. The first one said the time zone "still needs checking," which was accurate, and the second corrected the status. I should have checked the schedule before posting, so the channel got two notes where one would do.

Once the gateway is running and the schedule is correct, I'll confirm here. Until then, the job will not post anything.
